Jordan —

Thanks for sending this over and for the draft. High level answers below so you can pass to your legal/marketing teams:

1) Customer quote: We require sign-off on the final quote text and the embargo timing (we generally ask for 24–48 hours prior review). We can give approval within 1 business day once legal signs off.

2) Logo use: Small logo + link is fine. We just ask for a usage sample and adherence to your brand guidelines (file attached). We prefer the Redwood logo not be co-branded in a way that implies endorsement of product integrations.

3) Confidentiality carveout / joint press: Redwood's standard MSA allows publicity with mutual consent. We typically redline to: (a) require mutual written approval of release text, (b) permit a one-week embargo option, and (c) allow a limited quote attribution.

I'm looping in Marissa for marketing ops and Kimberly for final legal language. Can you confirm the signature timeline? If you're aiming for this week, we should finalize wording by end of Thursday PST.

Thanks —
Jonas
Enterprise Sales

Subject: Re: Request: quote + logo use language in MSA/Order Form — legal positions and redlines

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the draft. I reviewed Catalyst's proposed Order Form language and here are Redwood's positions (high level) plus what we'll include in the attached redline (msa_redline_v2.pdf):

1) Publicity carveout: Redwood accepts a joint press release provision provided (i) mutual written approval of the release text is required, (ii) each party retains the right to withhold approval for reasonable commercial or regulatory reasons, and (iii) no material confidential information is disclosed without specific consent. We'll propose adding a 72-hour review window rather than 48 to allow for legal checkpoints.

2) Customer quote: Redwood requires a short attribution clause — final quote must be submitted in writing and approved by Redwood prior to publication. We will allow the exact wording to be edited for length or to remove confidential technical details.

3) Logo and brand assets: Redwood requires that logo use comply with Catalyst's brand guidelines; Redwood will provide a logo usage guide on request. Catalyst may use Redwood's name and logo to identify us as a vendor but not in a way that implies joint product endorsements. We ask that any third-party marketing materials that include the Redwood logo be shared for review.

4) Confidentiality interplay: We will add a sentence specifying that the publicity carveout does not override confidentiality obligations for trade secrets, pricing, or other sensitive financial data.

Next steps: I attached our redline (msa_redline_v2.pdf) and a short checklist for production (see below). Please review and let us know if Catalyst counsel has specific counter-language. If we can get agreement on these points today, we can append the redline to the signature package.

Production checklist (for sign-off):
- Final quote text (one paragraph, 45 words max) — send to marissa.cole@redwood.com
- Logo (SVG/PNG) and preferred placement — send to marketing
- Embargo date/time, if desired — specify in email
- Signed Order Form with reference to redline(s) attached

If Catalyst prefers, we can accept a 48-hour review window for non-sensitive releases, but we'd like 72 hours for anything that mentions performance metrics or pricing.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
(olga.petrov@redwood.com)
